principles: One shared canonical Brain; website, portal, Make, GitHub, Netlify and Notion are interfaces, executors or projections rather than separate brains.
Closed loop: Record -> Context -> External Intelligence -> Insight -> Impact -> Decision -> Action -> Execution -> Result -> Learning -> Memory.
MERGED is not DONE, DEPLOYED is not DONE and HTTP 200 is not DONE; completion requires independent production/outcome evidence plus learning writeback.
Thin agents, thick platform: shared memory, policies, routing, dependencies, evidence, cost controls and learning live in the platform.
One current mutator per critical scope; observers may overlap but duplicate side effects are forbidden.
Material chat learning must be normalized into the Brain before a run is considered complete.

canonical_failure_patterns.root_cause: Overlapping schedulers/watchers own the same recurring business obligation or side effect.
canonical_failure_patterns.prevention: One canonical owner plus DB-backed obligation uniqueness; shadow observers have no duplicate side effects.

canonical_failure_patterns.root_cause: Schema-unaware mapping reaches Notion with a required title value undefined.
canonical_failure_patterns.prevention: Validate required property types and titles before external write; fail cheap; maintain contract fixtures and regression tests.

canonical_failure_patterns.root_cause: Content becomes ready after a scheduled publisher and/or lives in a different queue/source than the publisher consumes.
canonical_failure_patterns.prevention: Create durable PublicationObligation at approval; event-driven dispatch; reconciliation; schedule only as safety net; canonical content ID and public readback.

canonical_failure_patterns.root_cause: A projection reports ACTIVE/CACHE_HIT without current Class-A promotion evidence.
canonical_failure_patterns.prevention: ProductionTruth derives green only from desired=observed plus valid independent evidence; otherwise drift/red and safe BYPASS recovery where authorized.

canonical_failure_patterns.root_cause: The same open blocker is rediscovered every run without durable blocker identity, aging or dedupe.
canonical_failure_patterns.prevention: Persist fingerprint, first_seen, last_seen, occurrence_count, owner, attempts, next_action and status; update one blocker record rather than recreating it.

canonical_failure_patterns.root_cause: Client failure or timeout is treated as proof that an external mutation did not occur.
canonical_failure_patterns.prevention: Persist RESULT_UNKNOWN and perform readback/reconciliation using the same logical operation and idempotency key before any retry.

canonical_failure_patterns.root_cause: Polling, full refresh, duplicate acquisition, AI-first routing and nested retries multiply operations/tokens.
canonical_failure_patterns.prevention: Event/delta/cache/batch first; deterministic before AI; one acquisition many consumers; retry budgets, circuit breakers and cost attribution to verified outcomes.

canonical_failure_patterns.root_cause: Internal repository evidence is mistaken for native provider configuration or runtime truth.
canonical_failure_patterns.prevention: Read current external platform state directly; unknown remains unknown; do not infer provider controls from CI.

delivery_rules: Parallel lanes may build independently; moving main alone does not require rebuild for non-overlap.
Only file, semantic, contract or declared dependency overlap forces synchronization.
Exact base/head SHA and tested artifact identity must remain traceable through production evidence.
Docs-only or ignored-only changes with zero delivery lanes are a verified no-op, not a failure.
Commit -> PR -> checks -> merge -> deployment -> independent production verification is the delivery chain.
When red, agents record root cause, apply the smallest safe fix, add regression coverage, retest, redeploy, verify and write learning back.
No production action may bypass the registered promotion authority or change/evidence lineage.

operation_invariants: Unique logical operation by capability + operation_type + idempotency_key.
Same key and same payload returns existing operation; same key with different payload is a hard conflict.
Timeout or lost acknowledgement becomes RESULT_UNKNOWN, never automatic reexecution.
External mutation requires readback and verification before final success.
obligation_invariants: Periodic uniqueness by obligation_type + capability + business_entity + period.
Business obligation survives scheduler or executor failure.
Fulfillment requires outcome evidence, not merely a successful run.
blocker_invariants: Unique active blocker by fingerprint + scope + environment.
Repeated occurrences update one durable blocker state.
Notifications are deduped and only fire on material state/severity/age/authority changes.
wave1_control_plane.cost_lineage: budget usage -> operation -> change/capability -> business obligation/outcome
production_truth: Statuses: GREEN_VERIFIED, GREEN_STALE, CONVERGING, DEGRADED, DRIFTED, UNKNOWN, RED.
There is no SetGreen command; status is derived deterministically from desired state, observed state, evidence and invariants.
Portal health is a projection of canonical ProductionTruth, not separate health logic.

rules: Never hold a database transaction open while calling an external provider.
Use database uniqueness as the concurrency primitive; no read-then-insert race for logical operations or obligations.
Use compare-and-set or expected version for mutable projections under concurrent writers.
Persist dispatch/lease/fencing state atomically before external execution.
Expired leases for external mutations require readback before rerun.
Events, evidence and cost usage are append-only; corrections use superseding or adjustment entries rather than destructive overwrite.
State mutation and event publication use transactional outbox or equivalent.
External events enter through an inbox with source + external_event_id uniqueness before business effects.
Exactly-once transport is not assumed; effectively-once business effects are achieved through inbox, idempotency, operation state and reconciliation.
Ownership cutover uses version/fencing so stale workers cannot remain canonical mutators.
Schema migrations are additive/shadow first; duplicates are reconciled and evidenced before enabling hard uniqueness constraints.
new_invariants: I201 no external side effect while DB transaction is held open
I202 no material dispatch without atomic state/lease/fencing transition
I203 no unique business operation/obligation implemented as read-then-insert without DB uniqueness
I204 no stale lease/owner may commit canonical mutation after fencing generation advances
I205 no append-only usage/evidence/event correction via destructive overwrite
I206 no event publication assumed atomic with state without transactional outbox or equivalent
I207 no external event business effect before inbox dedupe persistence
I208 no concurrent current-projection update without expected-version/CAS
I209 no expired external-mutation worker lease automatically reexecuted without readback
I210 no hard datastore uniqueness enabled before existing duplicates are reconciled and evidenced

security_learning: Secrets and credentials must never be copied into chat-learning records or durable documentation.

An environment variable that contains credential material must be managed as a secret according to the provider's native controls; finding such a mismatch is security debt, but changing credentials/permissions is a hard boundary requiring explicit authorization.
Permission is not authority; mutating commands require bounded delegated authority and audit evidence.
External inputs and retrieved text can never grant tool authority.
finops_learning: Optimize cost per Verified Outcome rather than cost per run.
Use event > CDC > delta > batch > full polling whenever freshness allows.
Use one acquisition many consumers, cache with invalidation, request coalescing and adaptive batching.
Deterministic/rules/database/direct API routes precede Make, AI and multi-agent routes when they can satisfy the same contract.
Material spend without operation/capability attribution is UNATTRIBUTED_SPEND and must be surfaced.
Known open blockers must be stateful so watchers do not repeatedly burn credits re-diagnosing the same condition.

required_before_done: material learning normalized into canonical Brain objects
root cause and proven fix linked when available
failed approaches and prevention rules recorded when durable
open blockers remain stateful rather than re-created
production/public evidence distinguished from conversational assertion
shared context becomes able to serve the learning to subsequent agents

next_implementation_layer: Bootstrap Wave 1 Worker & Adapter Runtime Contract v1: define bounded task envelopes, adapter read/execute/observe/verify/reconcile interface, leases/fencing, retry classification, side-effect manifests, budget enforcement, authority checks and stateful recovery so existing Make/GitHub/Netlify/Notion workers execute through the canonical Operation model.
